profile.headline: Sr Software Engineer | AI Solutions Architect | Full Stack | Jack of All Trades (master of some)
profile.summary:
Driven by a passion for programming, I bring a diverse background from my long tech career  spanning software development, data analysis, automation, and quality assurance testing.

I am skilled at leveraging AI to optimize productivity while maintaining an evolving understanding of the associated challenges of AI-assisted work concerning security, accuracy, and safety.

 Technology is not only my career but also a hobby – I thrive on continuous learning and embracing new challenges in this ever-evolving industry.


Core Skills

Software Development (any language), AI-driven productivity, SQL, and shell scripting, Advanced Excel modeling, Git Version Control, Command-Line, Pandas Data transformation, Relational Databases, ORM, REST API, Agile QA, Web Development, Root Cause analysis, Azure cloud

Personal Traits

- Passionate about technology
- Quick learner
- Excellent written communication and documentation skills
- Experienced in serving clients as an onsite vendor
- Leadership experience with local and overseas teams
- Excellent references and work history

Ideal Company

- Offers remote work opportunities
- Encourages creative freedom and continuing education
- Promotes a healthy work-life balance
- Fosters an environment of knowledge-sharing and continuous improvement
- Provides opportunities for programming and automation (building things!)

Contact Email: heathergray153@gmail.com

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description: Developing full stack enterprise software and automations for intermodal, finished vehicle, and depot service terminals. C#, .NET 8 with Docker and Kubernetes, Azure SQL, Python, Flask, & JavaScript.
positions.insights: Skills: Full-Stack Development · C# · .NET Framework · ASP.NET MVC · Entity Framework · Python (Programming Language) · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · JavaScript · Flask · Azure SQL · Microsoft Azure · Azure Cosmos DB · Linux · Azure DevOps Services · Back-End Web Development · Azure Functions · Docker · Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Converting legacy enterprise applications to fullstack web apps using Python,  Flask,  SQL and Bootstrap with Azure Cosmos db.
positions.insights: Skills: SQL · Flask · Progress 4GL · Azure Cosmos DB · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: Data Analyst / Python & VBA Developer
positions.description:
Contracting with Insight Global remote for HP Inc
- Data Wrangling and transformation using Pandas and SQL
- Internal app development using Python and PyQT
- Use of Azure DevOps, Visual Studio Code, and Git Version Control
- Develop complex automated tools to analyze and present clean and attractive data reports
-  On-demand analysis and metrics
- Automation of data quality checks and scheduled reporting using Python and PowerShell scripts
- Document & implement processes. Improve processes, efficiency, and communication of the data management team to provide better service to our HP clients. 
- Basic database and server maintenance, troubleshooting, and support for team systems.
positions.insights: Skills: SQL · Data Modeling · Python (Programming Language) · Visual Basic for Applications (VBA) · Microsoft SQL Server

positions.title: Full Time Student - Computer Science & Database
positions.description:
Graduated with honors on 12/12/2017 with an A.A.S. degree in Programming and a certificate in Database. (one class shy of a degree in Database as well)
Studied Computer Science, programming, database, and a little web development. Formerly self-taught, I wanted to experience college for the first time.
I've also completed several online courses (see courses & certificate section) 
Continued independently in the areas of Programming and SQL

positions.title: Business Intelligence Analyst
positions.description:
Produced weekly and monthly reports and data models using Excel, SQL, and VBA to analyze product performance statistics from technical support call center data. Cleaned, modeled, and visualized data. Created and presented PowerPoints to engineers and program managers. Extensive use of PivotTables, charts, and graphs, as well as PowerPivot. Used SQL to interface with Oracle Database to access and further analyze data. Suggested and implemented custom dashboards and views for users. Worked one-on-one with engineers and Quality Account Managers to drill down and discover patterns in data. Worked remotely.

Skills: Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Business Intelligence, SQL, Toad for Oracle, Oracle, PowerPivot, ETL, Dashboards, VBA, Automation

positions.title: Test Lead
positions.description:
Experience in testing digital imaging devices such as scanners and digital cameras, home servers. Some workstation testing experience.

-Audio/Video Streaming
 -Audio Video conversion formats
-Windows Home Server OS 
-Localization functionality testing on Mac and Windows
-Daily direction of testing activities to test lead and test team 
-Daily review of overseas team's defects & test results. 
-Feedback and mentoring on test methodologies.  
-Determination of priorities and goals for the test project.  
-Test data analysis through Excel pivot reports, and weekly progress reporting to supervisor and client.  
-R&D request handling, special request testing, defect investigation.  
-Remote work in the evenings giving additional direction to China's test lead.  
-Experience with Mercury Quality Center 9.2 and QuickTest Pro.

positions.title: Web Application Tester
positions.description: Testing web-based online learning solution at a start-up

positions.title: Validation Technician
positions.description:
-Testing BIOS ROMs, CPU, Motherboards, Audio, Video and UDMA drivers on multiple configurations.  
- Building & troubleshooting breadboard test systems. 
- Writing technical reports, maintaining personal project web pages, binary\hex conversions, voltage readings, installation and configuration of multiple operating systems (Linux, Win95/98/NT/3.1/2000), installation and configuration of PCI, ISA and SCSI devices
- Hard drive cloning, partitioning and formatting, 
- Automated and diagnostic test experience (stress testing, scripting tools, benchmarks), test case maintenance design verification testing, presentations, team meetings, high-security environment

positions.title: Software Tester
positions.description: Testing C++ application, updating\developing test plans and test cases, defect reporting and tracking through MS Access database, beta project preparation, regression and ad-hoc testing.

volunteerExperiences.description: Computer data entry of gift requests for needy families in Fort Collins.
